name: BioStation 3
tagLine: Next-generation fingerprint and face recognition access terminal.
summary:
The BioStation 3 sets a new benchmark for biometric access control, integrating Suprema's latest deep-learning fingerprint algorithm with an advanced IR face recognition engine in a compact, modern design. With a 4.3-inch colour touchscreen and support for both on-premise (BioStar 2) and cloud (BioStar Air) management, the BioStation 3 adapts to any deployment model.

Ideal for high-traffic entry points where speed and hygiene matter — the BioStation 3 authenticates users in under a second, with anti-spoofing technology that rejects printed photos and 3D masks.

features.title: Deep-learning fingerprint algorithm
features.description: Suprema's 5th-generation algorithm delivers class-leading accuracy even on worn or damaged fingerprints.

features.title: IR face recognition
features.description: Anti-spoofing IR face authentication works in direct sunlight and low light — no masks required.

features.title: BioStar 2 & BioStar Air ready
features.description: Supports both on-premise and cloud-based access management out of the box.

features.title: OSDP v2 support
features.description: Encrypted, bidirectional communication with access controllers for maximum security.
